hardGateFindings.finding: Control state and public governance consistently preserve hiring, reader, collaborator, application, and job-search outcomes as not-yet-measured; all outward protocols remain explicitly planned rather than completed.

All eight blind spots have distinct signals, controls, triggers, owners, decision rules, next tests, and evidence-return paths. Deterministic inspection found the graph snapshot, role and proof ledgers, route inventories, source-balance coverage, and safety receipt current and internally consistent.

The governance model separates deterministic checks, digest-bound read-only LLM judgments, orchestration receipts, and external human validation; it requires distinct sessions, excludes the generator as judge, and identifies repository provenance as auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof.

Record-level guardrails are paired with a current combination-level mosaic review covering affiliation, movement, collaborator, platform, educational-record, and feedback risks. The controls minimize unnecessary detail and keep private feedback, participant data, protected locators, and relationship graphs outside public surfaces.

limitations: This is an LLM repository-control evaluation, not human reader research, collaborator review, deployment approval, application evidence, or a hiring outcome.
External outcomes remain not-yet-measured; no reader-study, field-action, or job-search completion receipt exists because those protocols remain planned.
The stale current run, prior judge artifacts, prior result scores, conversation memory, private archives, and external facts were not used as evidence.
